sentence: Across the tested degenerate hypergraph-product codes ([[5,1,2]], [[8,1,2]], [[13,1,3]]) at code capacity with p = 0.1, 100.0% of avoidable BP+OSD failures are degenerate ambiguities, and a fractional LP optimum flags an avoidable BP+OSD failure with 47.6% precision (100.0% recall); the non-degenerate [[7,1,3]] Steane code has no avoidable BP+OSD failures at this p.
